criteria_amendments.what: held_out.freeze_required_before_use ties the final freeze and the held-out run to the live-verification result. This amendment PERMITS a DETERMINISTIC-BASELINE-ONLY freeze and held-out evaluation of the registered seeds (9101, 9102, 9103) while live Gemini verification remains PENDING. The freeze covers the source, generator, configurations, evaluation definitions (this file and evals/heldout_protocol.yaml), scenario files, seed list and reporting rules; its identifier and manifest are recorded in evals/FREEZE_MANIFEST.json and a git tag. The held-out evaluation measures ONLY the frozen rules-only baseline (forecasting, policy decisions against the committed scenario expectations, abstentions, scenario-validity diagnostics). This amendment does NOT authorize any claim about live-agent performance, any agent-vs-baseline comparison, or the use of these seeds as an untouched holdout for a later agent evaluation: once the baseline run has used them, a later agent evaluation must use fresh seeds or disclose that these seeds were already evaluated.
criteria_amendments.why: Live verification is blocked by a recorded billing state (HTTP 402) and may not be resolved in time; the deterministic baseline is complete and can be evaluated honestly on additional synthetic seeds without it. Evaluating the baseline separately does not weaken the claim boundary for the agent.

tool_budget_amendment.recorded_note: hard bound on executed tool calls per run (errors count); exceeding it falls back to the rules-only proposal. AMENDMENT (kept on record): this was 20, an unfounded first guess made before any live run. The second live attempt (gemini-3.5-flash) investigated carefully and made 20 error-free calls in five turns (overview + 4 per-channel tools x 5 channels = 21 before any planning call), so the bound cut off a legitimate investigation and both cases fell back (loop_limit). 40 covers that sweep plus planning, constraint checks and a repair. It is still a hard bound; it was NOT raised to obtain a particular outcome.
